subject: Renewal fast-path: procurement onboarding sync & PO handoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Globex renewal — procurement fast-path prep

Team — quick note to align before we hit the procure portal. Globex is asking for a shortened renewal flow because they’re combining a 12‑month term change with a +40% capacity uplift for Q3 consumption. Legal already cleared the SOW amendment (see attached draft).

Key asks: 
- Laura: can you own direct procurement handoff and PO submission once portal-side clears? Target: PO in by next Wednesday (5/5).
- Marissa: please include the SOC2 attestation and the evidence bundle (we'll mark the critical items) so procurement can fast‑track vendor re-registration.
- Jonas: raise PSL priority in the console to match the uplift so ops knows the start date.

Proposed timeline: vendor re-register (today), portal review (1 business day), PO issuance (by 5/5). If procurement wants a signed amendment before PO, we have the doc ready.

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference
Attachments: amendment-sow-v2.docx (DOCX)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Li <susan.li@globex.com>, procure-support@globex.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement onboarding: renewal + capacity increase (Globex)

Hi Susan / Procure team — looping you in to start a compact procurement flow for Globex (deal GXB-2024-447). We’re executing a term adjustment and a capacity increase (+40%) — customer wants the renewal and PO completed quickly so their Q3 projects can proceed.

What we’ve attached for the portal: 
- SOC2 attestation (most recent)
- Evidence bundle with redacted invoices + data flow diagram
- Draft SOW amendment (legal approved)

High level asks from procurement: 
1) Can Globex re-register Redwood as a vendor under the fast-path queue?
2) Do you need the signed amendment before releasing PO, or will a countersigned DocuSign link + the invoice sample suffice?
3) Please confirm the PO number format and any procurement codes needed.

Timeline we’re aiming for: vendor re-registration + portal review today, PO issued by 2027-05-05. If there are missing items, let us know immediately and we’ll upload to the portal.

Attachments: soc2-attestation-2026.pdf (PDF); evidence-bundle-2027.zip (ZIP); amendment-sow-v2.docx (DOCX)

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Renewals, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199
Redwood Inference
From: Susan Li <susan.li@globex.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure-support@globex.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 13:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement onboarding: renewal + capacity increase (Globex)

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick packet. We can run this through the portal fast-path but will need the following to complete vendor re-registration: 
- Completed vendor-registration-form (attached)
- W-9 or equivalent tax doc (US entity)
- Sample invoice layout (we use it to validate AP fields)

Portal note: please use this link to submit vendor docs: https://portal.globexprocure.com/fastpath/register (portal wants PDFs only). If you submit the SOC2 and evidence bundle there and mark the request "Fast-Track", our team will triage inside the same business day.

SOW amendment — we can accept a DocuSign countersign + signed copy attached to the portal; PO issuance generally follows once vendor registration is complete. If your legal marks the amendment as urgent we can push it to priority review and pull the PO forward.

Attachments: vendor-registration-form.pdf; PO-Template.pdf

Best,
Susan
Susan Li
Senior Procurement Manager, Globex Corp
susan.li@globex.com | +1 212-555-0432

Quick update — vendor re-registration completed via portal (I uploaded SOC2, evidence bundle, W-9, and the signed amendment DocuSign link). Portal ticket #GP-7124 is in fast-path triage. Procure team confirmed they’ll issue PO once the registration finishes; estimated PO delivery by EOD Monday 5/3 if triage clears.

I also attached the PO template they requested and added the deal code GXB-2024-447 in the portal notes. I queued a payables contact for our finance team in case AP needs direct coordination.

Next steps for us: 
- Marissa — please double-check the evidence bundle index to surface the SOC items procurement may request during triage.
- Aditya — I'll ping you once PO number is live so you can update the customer and close the renewal.
- Jonas — ops: plan for capacity uplift on 2027-05-15 if PO comes in on 5/3.
